title: Tropical Cyclone Attributes in Sparse Autoencoder Features of an AI Weather Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.28904v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) weather models now forecast weather events skillfully, but how they represent these events internally remains unknown. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) provide sparse features for probing hidden states, but how information about multiple physical attributes of an event is organized across them remains unclear. Using tropical cyclones in GraphCast as a test case, we analyze 2,115 six-hourly timesteps from 205 cyclones, relating SAE activations to position, intensity, and pressure structure across five Layer-8 decompositions and 16 processor layers. Each attribute relates to multiple features; position and pressure-structure relations overlap in a smaller subset. This organization recurs across independent SAEs and layers without feature alignment. translated_title: AI气象模型稀疏自编码器特征中的热带气旋属性
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）气象模型如今已能熟练地预报天气事件，但它们在内部如何表征这些事件仍然未知。稀疏自编码器（SAE）为探测隐藏状态提供了稀疏特征，但关于事件多个物理属性的信息如何在这些特征之间组织仍不清楚。以GraphCast中的热带气旋作为测试案例，我们分析了来自205个气旋的2,115个六小时时间步，将SAE激活与位置、强度和气压结构相关联，涵盖五种第8层分解和16个处理器层。每个属性都与多个特征相关；位置和气压结构的关系在较小的子集中重叠。这种组织方式在独立的SAE和各层之间重复出现，无需特征对齐。在更深层中，主要的位置特征与六小时后的位置和气压结构的对齐程度优于当前时刻。这些结果表明，这种组织……
tldr: 该研究以GraphCast中的热带气旋为案例，通过稀疏自编码器（SAE）探测AI气象模型的内部表征，发现气旋的位置、强度和气压结构信息以跨独立SAE和层间可重复的方式分布于多个特征中，且深层特征更能预测气旋六小时后的状态。
en_tdlr: Using tropical cyclones in GraphCast as a test case, this study shows that sparse autoencoder features of an AI weather model organize cyclone position, intensity, and pressure-structure information consistently across independent SAEs and layers, with deeper-layer features aligning better with the cyclone's state six hours ahead.
